query.name: net.cdolinc.custom.dats.psee.handbook_url
query.description: Returns the handbook URL selected by the student's enrollment PSEE_SCHOOL_ID.
query.sql: SELECT TRIM(school_settings.HANDBOOK_URL) AS handbook_url FROM Students student_record INNER JOIN U_STUDENT_ENROLLMENT_LOGIC enrollment_logic ON enrollment_logic.StudentsDCID = student_record.DCID INNER JOIN Schools enrollment_school ON enrollment_school.School_Number = enrollment_logic.PSEE_SCHOOL_ID INNER JOIN U_SCHOOL_ENROLL_SETTINGS school_settings ON school_settings.SchoolsDCID = enrollment_school.DCID WHERE student_record.DCID = :coretabledcid

query.name: net.cdolinc.custom.dats.students.contacts
query.description: PowerQuery DAT to return all active contacts for a student, inactive contact details or end-date contact details are excluded.modified from Mike Gerszewski's one on PowerSchool Exchange
query.sql: select chr(60) || 'span style="font-weight: bold;"' || chr(62) || p.firstname || ' ' || p.LASTNAME || chr(60) || '/span' || chr(62) || case when personemails.emails is not null then incolumnsep.sep || personemails.emails else '' end Name , crcs.code Relationship , personphones.phones , personaddr.addresses , case when scd.ISCUSTODIAL=1 then '✔️' else '❌' end || ' Custodial' || incolumnsep.sep || case when scd.LIVESWITHFLG=1 then '✔️' else '❌' end || ' Lives With Student' || incolumnsep.sep || case when scd.SCHOOLPICKUPFLG=1 then '✔️' else '❌' end || ' School Pickup' || incolumnsep.sep || case when scd.ISEMERGENCY=1 then '✔️' else '❌' end || ' Emergency' || incolumnsep.sep || case when scd.RECEIVESMAILFLG=1 then '✔️' else '❌' end ||' Mailings' || incolumnsep.sep flags from students students INNER JOIN studentContactAssoc sca ON students.dcid = sca.studentdcid INNER JOIN studentContactDetail scd ON sca.studentcontactassocid = scd.studentcontactassocid AND scd.isactive = 1 AND sysdate <= coalesce(scd.ENDDATE, sysdate) INNER JOIN /*(select person.ID, person.ISACTIVE, person.FIRSTNAME, person.LASTNAME, person.PREFIXCODESETID, person.SUFFIXCODESETID, person.GENDERCODESETID from person person) p*/ (SELECT contactpersonid id, isactive, contactfirstname firstname, contactlastname lastname, prefixcodesetid, suffixcodesetid, gendercodesetid, studentdcid from PSSIS_STU_CONTACT_ACT psca) p ON sca.personid = p.id AND p.studentdcid = students.dcid AND p.ISACTIVE = 1 INNER JOIN codeset rcs ON scd.relationshiptypecodesetid = rcs.codesetid inner join ( select case when 'br' = 'br' then chr(60) || 'br' || chr(62) else null end sep from dual ) incolumnsep on 1=1 left join (select personid , listagg(emailwtype, sep) emails from( select personemailaddressassoc.PERSONID , emailaddress.emailaddress emailwtype , incolumnsep.sep from emailaddress inner join PERSONEMAILADDRESSASSOC on emailaddress.EMAILADDRESSID = PERSONEMAILADDRESSASSOC.EMAILADDRESSID inner join codeset on PERSONEMAILADDRESSASSOC.EMAILTYPECODESETID = codeset.CODESETID inner join ( select case when 'br' = 'br' then chr(60) || 'br' || chr(62) else '' end sep from dual ) incolumnsep on 1=1 order by PERSONEMAILADDRESSASSOC.EMAILADDRESSPRIORITYORDER ) group by PERSONID, sep ) personemails on personemails.personid = p.id left join (select personid , listagg(phonewtype, sep) phones from ( select PERSONPHONENUMBERASSOC.PERSONID , ( CASE WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(TRIM(TO_CHAR(phonenumber.PHONENUMBER)), '^1\d{10}$') THEN REGEXP_REPLACE( TRIM(TO_CHAR(phonenumber.PHONENUMBER)), '^1(\d{3})(\d{3})(\d{4})$', '1-\1-\2-\3' ) WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(TRIM(TO_CHAR(phonenumber.PHONENUMBER)), '^\d{10}$') THEN REGEXP_REPLACE( TRIM(TO_CHAR(phonenumber.PHONENUMBER)), '^(\d{3})(\d{3})(\d{4})$', '\1-\2-\3' ) ELSE TRIM(TO_CHAR(phonenumber.PHONENUMBER)) END ) || ' (' || COALESCE(codeset.DISPLAYVALUE, codeset.CODE, '') || ')' AS phonewtype , incolumnsep.sep from PHONENUMBER inner join PERSONPHONENUMBERASSOC on PHONENUMBER.PHONENUMBERID = PERSONPHONENUMBERASSOC.PHONENUMBERID inner join codeset on PERSONPHONENUMBERASSOC.PHONETYPECODESETID = codeset.CODESETID inner join ( select case when 'br' = 'br' then chr(60) || 'br' || chr(62) else '' end sep from dual ) incolumnsep on 1=1 order by PERSONPHONENUMBERASSOC.PHONENUMBERPRIORITYORDER ) group by PERSONID, sep ) personphones on personphones.personid = p.id left join (select personid , listagg(addrwtype, sep) addresses from( select PERSONADDRESSASSOC.PERSONID , case when length(codeset.code)> 0 then chr(60) || 'span style="font-weight: bold;"' || chr(62) || codeset.CODE || ':' || chr(60) || '/span' || chr(62) || incolumnsep.sep else '' end || personaddress.STREET || case when length(personaddress.unit) > 0 then ' Apt ' || personaddress.unit else '' end || incolumnsep.sep || case when length(personaddress.LINETWO) > 0 then personaddress.LINETWO || incolumnsep.sep else '' end || personaddress.CITY || ', ' || states.code || ' ' || personaddress.POSTALCODE addrwtype , incolumnsep.sep || incolumnsep.sep sep from PERSONADDRESS inner join PERSONADDRESSASSOC on PERSONADDRESS.PERSONADDRESSID = PERSONADDRESSASSOC.PERSONADDRESSID AND sysdate <= coalesce(PERSONADDRESSASSOC.ENDDATE, sysdate) inner join codeset on PERSONADDRESSASSOC.ADDRESSTYPECODESETID = codeset.CODESETID left join codeset states on personaddress.STATESCODESETID = states.CODESETID inner join ( select case when 'br' = 'br' then chr(60) || 'br' || chr(62) else '' end sep from dual ) incolumnsep on 1=1 order by PERSONADDRESSASSOC.ADDRESSPRIORITYORDER ) group by PERSONID, sep ) personaddr on personaddr.personid = p.id LEFT JOIN codeset crcs ON sca.currreltypecodesetid = crcs.codesetid LEFT JOIN codeset pcs ON p.prefixcodesetid = pcs.codesetid LEFT JOIN codeset scs ON p.suffixcodesetid = scs.codesetid LEFT JOIN codeset gcs ON p.gendercodesetid = gcs.codesetid where students.dcid = :coretabledcid order by sca.CONTACTPRIORITYORDER

query.name: net.cdolinc.student.sat.satdate
query.description: List Date of SAT day for Current Term
query.sql: WITH latest_term AS ( SELECT firstday, lastday FROM terms WHERE schoolid = 160 AND TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN TRUNC(firstday) AND TRUNC(lastday) AND id = (SELECT MAX(id) FROM terms WHERE schoolid = 160 AND TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN TRUNC(firstday) AND TRUNC(lastday)) ) SELECT TRIM(TO_CHAR(calendar_day.date_value, 'Day')) || ', ' || TO_CHAR(calendar_day.date_value, 'Month') || '' || TO_CHAR(calendar_day.date_value, 'DD') || CASE WHEN TO_CHAR(calendar_day.date_value, 'DD') = '01' OR TO_CHAR(calendar_day.date_value, 'DD') = '21' OR TO_CHAR(calendar_day.date_value, 'DD') = '31' THEN 'st' WHEN TO_CHAR(calendar_day.date_value, 'DD') = '02' OR TO_CHAR(calendar_day.date_value, 'DD') = '22' THEN 'nd' WHEN TO_CHAR(calendar_day.date_value, 'DD') = '03' OR TO_CHAR(calendar_day.date_value, 'DD') = '23' THEN 'rd' ELSE 'th' END as date_value FROM calendar_day JOIN (SELECT * FROM latest_term) latest_term ON TRUNC(calendar_day.date_value) BETWEEN TRUNC(latest_term.firstday) AND TRUNC(latest_term.lastday) WHERE calendar_day.schoolid = 160 AND calendar_day.note LIKE '%SAT%'
